links.outcome: Answer reproducibility across repeated runs of the same exam questions
links.effect: When the exam was repeated months later, GPT-4 chose a different answer 25.5% of the time, with a small, insignificant decrease in accuracy.
links.quote: When the questions were repeated, GPT-4 chose a different answer 25.5% of the time and there was a small but insignificant decrease in accuracy.

links.outcome: Model-stated confidence for correct versus incorrect answers
links.effect: Confidence was 87.1% for correct answers and 84.0% for incorrect answers (p = 0.012), so confidence was high even when wrong. Overall accuracy was 58.5%.
links.quote: GPT-4 showed significantly higher (p = 0.012) confidence for correct answers (87.1%) compared to incorrect (84.0%).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and temporal stability (model drift) of GPT-4 on the American College of Radiology in-service examination without evaluating a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
